newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse pursues its downward trend.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse pursues its downward trend.

text.p: Tunis stock exchange on Wednesday closed down by 0.22 percent, pursuing its lower trend for a second consecutive day, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 452.41 points, down from 453.39 on Tuesday.
Coca and beer bottler Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis fell 2.42 dinars to 78.58 with only ten shares changing hands.
In the banking sector, Banque Nationale Agricole was down 0.53 dinar to 18.21 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie slid 0.5 dinar to 29.5.
Societe Tunisienne de Banque declined 0.37 dinar to 12.08 dinars with the exchange of 5,779 shares.
Chemical firm Alkimia edged 0.46 dinar lower to 40 dinars.
Airline Tunis Air was down 0.24 dinar to 23.04 dinars with 3,204 shares changing hands.
Amen Bank rose 0.78 dinar to 31.78 dinars.
Total volume was 615,172 dinars against 370,163 dinars over the previous session.
